summary.short: Italian legislative decree adapting national law to the EU AI Act: names national AI and market-surveillance authorities (AgID, ACN, Banca d'Italia, CONSOB, IVASS, Garante), sets their powers and fines, creates an AI regulatory sandbox, and adds AI rules on training, employment, health and trade secrets. Dated 7 October 2026.
summary.long: Legislative decree No. 179 of 7 October 2026 adapts Italian law to the EU AI Act and to Law 132/2025 on AI. It names AgID as notifying authority and ACN as AI authority and single point of contact, and designates ACN, Banca d'Italia, CONSOB, IVASS and the Garante as market-surveillance authorities for their sectors. ACN keeps a national register of certain high-risk systems and holds inspection powers. Fines for AI Act breaches reach EUR 35 million or 7% of worldwide turnover at the top tier, and warnings are possible for minor breaches. An Italian AI regulatory sandbox, run jointly by AgID and ACN, is created. Chapter III provides for AI training and literacy measures in education, professions, justice, health and public administration. Employers may not take employment decisions solely on automated processing and must inform workers; non-compliant decisions are void. Article 52 amends Article 98 of the Industrial Property Code so that AI training data and algorithms can qualify as protected trade secrets when Article 98(1) conditions are met. The text states no separate entry-into-force date beyond its adoption date. Implementation must not create new public charges (Art. 54).

notes: The export is the enacted decree dated Rome, 7 October 2026 (n. 179); it gives no publication or entry-into-force date, so periods counted from entry into force cannot be dated from this text. The registry title refers to schema AG 421; the annotation follows the adopted text. The text refers throughout to the AI Regulation and to Law 132/2025 ('legge IA') and incorporates their definitions by reference (Art. 1(1)-(2)). No numerical inconsistencies were found. Art. 24(4) ends with a publication-related sentence that is not clearly linked to its lettered list in the export. Target instrument IDs and entity LEI/ticker are empty strings because the schema requires strings and no identifiers were verified or in the registry. The section_status below is schema-required; relations and entities are populated.

obligations.summary: The financial sector authorities have supervisory and inspection powers over supervised financial institutions under the AI Regulation and Regulation (EU) 2019/1020, without prejudice to Art. 22 of Law 262/2005.

evidence.quote: le Autorità del settore finanziario dispongono, nei confronti degli istituti finanziari vigilati, dei poteri previsti dal regolamento IA

obligations.summary: The financial sector authorities sign a protocol of understanding with the Guardia di Finanza on information exchange for prevention and repression of economic and financial offences, and an analogous protocol with the DIA.

evidence.quote: Le Autorità del settore finanziario stipulano un protocollo d'intesa con il Corpo della guardia di finanza

obligations.summary: National market surveillance authorities receive complaints under AI Regulation Art. 85 and handle them under their own procedures, ensuring the right to adversarial hearing; a complaint sent to a non-competent authority is forwarded ex officio with notice to the complainant.

evidence.quote: ricevono i reclami ai sensi dell'articolo 85 del regolamento IA e li trattano secondo le procedure adottate da ciascuna

obligations.summary: ACN regulates by director-general decree the procedure for handling complaints within its competence.

evidence.quote: L'ACN disciplina la procedura per la trattazione dei reclami di cui al comma 1 di propria competenza con decreto del direttore generale

obligations.summary: Out-of-court dispute resolution bodies for financial customers (Arts. 128-bis TUB, 187.1 CAP, 32-ter TUF) handle appeals about AI Regulation violations by member financial institutions, where committed in their area of competence.

evidence.quote: sono competenti per i ricorsi relativi alle violazioni del regolamento IA compiute dagli istituti finanziari che aderiscono a tali organismi

obligations.summary: AgID and the national market surveillance authorities must take all measures necessary for correct and effective implementation of the sanctions section, taking into account AI Regulation Art. 99.

evidence.quote: adottano tutte le misure necessarie per garantire un'attuazione corretta ed efficace della presente sezione

obligations.summary: AgID and the market surveillance authorities must promptly inform ACN of administrative fines imposed and of related disputes or court proceedings; ACN is competent for the activity under AI Regulation Art. 99(11).

evidence.quote: informano tempestivamente l'ACN delle sanzioni amministrative pecuniarie applicate

obligations.summary: The Italian AI regulatory sandbox is established under the direct supervision of the national AI authorities, to support best-practice sharing, innovation and regulatory learning, and to ease market access for AI systems, especially from SMEs and start-ups.

evidence.quote: È istituito, sotto la vigilanza diretta delle Autorità nazionali per l'intelligenza artificiale, lo Spazio di sperimentazione italiano per l'IA

obligations.summary: AgID and ACN jointly provide, by decree of their directors general, for access to the controlled environment of the sandbox, its management and operation, coordinated by the Coordination Committee; Art. 26(4) requires objective and transparent admission criteria covering eligible entities, access priorities and maturity.

evidence.quote: Le modalità di accesso, di gestione e di funzionamento dello Spazio di sperimentazione italiano, di cui al primo periodo, sono stabilite con decreto adottato in forma congiunta dai direttori generali dell'AgID e dell'ACN

obligations.summary: Providers and prospective providers of AI systems may participate in the Italian sandbox through eligibility criteria identified and assessed under Art. 26(2)-(4) and the implementing decrees.
obligations.conditional_on: Participation in the Italian AI sandbox

evidence.quote: avviene mediante l'individuazione e la valutazione di criteri di eleggibilità

obligations.summary: The strategic management and general guidelines of the Italian sandbox are defined within the Coordination Committee, after consultation with stakeholders, Regions and Autonomous Provinces; the Committee sets experimentation priorities and selection order of providers.

evidence.quote: La gestione strategica e gli indirizzi generali dello Spazio di sperimentazione italiano per l'IA sono definiti nell'ambito del Comitato di coordinamento

obligations.summary: AgID and ACN must set up, by joint decree of their directors general, a parity-composed Operational Group that manages the sandbox; the Group monitors development, testing and validation by admitted providers, conducts preliminary admissibility review, selects projects, and approves and monitors test plans; the Ministry of University and Research contributes to technical requirements.

evidence.quote: l'AgID e l'ACN provvedono, mediante decreto adottato congiuntamente dai rispettivi direttori generali, a costituire un Gruppo operativo

obligations.summary: Decrees of the AgID and ACN directors general define the composition, functioning and operational modalities of the Operational Group, the services offered, and the eligibility criteria.

evidence.quote: sono definiti la composizione, il funzionamento e le modalità operative del Gruppo

obligations.summary: The national AI authorities must respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained in carrying out sandbox tasks, in accordance with AI Regulation Art. 78.

evidence.quote: Le Autorità nazionali per l'intelligenza artificiale rispettano la riservatezza delle informazioni e dei dati

obligations.summary: AgID supervises cooperation with notified bodies, in line with any implementing acts of the Commission under AI Regulation Art. 58.

evidence.quote: La cooperazione con gli organismi notificati è supervisionata da AgID

obligations.summary: Regulations adopted by decree of the President of the Council of Ministers, on proposal of the national AI authorities, define the establishment, management and operation of dual-use and judicial sandboxes (after consulting the Ministries of Defence and Justice), and the coordination with the FinTech sandbox (Art. 30(6)).

evidence.quote: le modalità di istituzione, gestione e funzionamento degli spazi di sperimentazione di sistemi di IA impiegabili in chiave duale

obligations.summary: Agreements set out the instruments for coordination between the Italian sandbox and regional and local sandboxes, and the criteria for including their results in the annual report under Art. 31.

evidence.quote: sono stabiliti gli strumenti di raccordo tra lo Spazio di sperimentazione italiano per l'IA

obligations.summary: The competent national authorities submit annual reports to the AI Office from the year after the sandbox is established, until its termination, plus a final report; the reports are transmitted through the Coordination Committee to the Presidency of the Council.
obligations.applies_from: from the year after the institution of the regulatory sandbox

evidence.quote: presentano relazioni annuali all'ufficio per l'IA a decorrere dall'anno successivo all'istituzione dello Spazio di sperimentazione normativa per l'IA

obligations.summary: Coordination and information exchanges under the decree, including those deviating from official secrecy, must comply with data protection law and the principles of necessity, proportionality and minimisation.

evidence.quote: avvengono, anche in deroga all'obbligo del segreto d'ufficio, nel rispetto della vigente normativa in materia di protezione dei dati personali

obligations.summary: The Ministry of Education and Merit updates the STEM guidelines to integrate AI; the Ministry of Labour contributes to analysis of emerging professional skills linked to STEAM and AI, and the Ministry updates national curriculum indications.

evidence.quote: Il Ministero dell'istruzione e del merito provvede all'aggiornamento delle linee guida per le discipline STEM

obligations.summary: The Ministry of Education and Merit launches, within 90 days, a teacher training plan on the use of social media and digital platforms, including educational actions for pupils and families.
obligations.applies_from: 90 days from entry into force of this decree

evidence.quote: avvia, entro novanta giorni dalla data di entrata in vigore del presente decreto, un piano di formazione

obligations.summary: A decree of the Minister of Education and Merit, to be adopted within 90 days, sets the criteria and modalities for AI training of school teachers and CPIA staff, and defines the interventions for students.
obligations.applies_from: 90 days from entry into force of this decree

evidence.quote: è erogata con i criteri e le modalità stabilite con decreto del Ministro dell'istruzione e del merito, da adottare entro novanta giorni dalla data di entrata in vigore del presente decreto

obligations.summary: CPIA, within their autonomy, promote adult AI-literacy courses, including methods for assessing and recognising prior and acquired competences.

evidence.quote: favoriscono la realizzazione di percorsi di ampliamento dell'offerta formativa finalizzati all'alfabetizzazione degli adulti

obligations.summary: The Minister for Public Administration directs and coordinates recruitment, training and reskilling policies for public employees for AI use.

evidence.quote: indirizza e coordina le politiche di reclutamento, di formazione di base, di formazione continua

obligations.summary: The Minister for Public Administration, after consulting AgID and ACN and agreeing with the Conferenza Stato-Regioni, sets by guidelines the minimum AI competence framework for public employees.

evidence.quote: definisce, con proprie linee guida, il quadro minimo di competenze sull'intelligenza artificiale necessarie al personale dipendente pubblico

obligations.summary: An employer using AI systems must ensure that final decisions on hiring, modification or termination of employment, including disciplinary and performance decisions, are not taken solely on the basis of automated processing; the final decision is reserved to a natural person with effective and autonomous power. Consent does not exempt from this rule.
obligations.conditional_on: Employer uses AI systems within the meaning of Art. 3(1) AI Regulation in employment decisions

evidence.quote: assicura che le decisioni finali relative alla costituzione, alla modificazione o alla risoluzione del rapporto, ivi compresi i provvedimenti disciplinari e le valutazioni delle prestazioni, non siano adottate unicamente sulla base di un trattamento automatizzato

obligations.summary: Use of AI systems in employment must respect worker dignity and confidentiality and the principle of non-discrimination.

evidence.quote: L'utilizzo dei sistemi di cui al comma 1 avviene nel rispetto della dignità e della riservatezza del lavoratore e del principio di non discriminazione

obligations.summary: Before starting processing, the employer must fulfil the information duties under Art. 1-bis of Legislative Decree 152/1997.

evidence.quote: Prima dell'avvio del trattamento, il datore di lavoro assolve agli obblighi di informativa previsti dall'articolo 1-bis del decreto legislativo 26 maggio 1997, n. 152

obligations.summary: On request, the worker is entitled to an intelligible reasoned explanation of a decision affecting them, provided through a natural person, including the extent of AI influence and main parameters considered; access and rights under GDPR Arts. 13, 15 and 22 remain.

evidence.quote: Il lavoratore ha diritto di ottenere, a richiesta e mediante l'intervento di una persona fisica, una motivazione intelligibile della decisione

obligations.summary: The Ministry of Labour and Social Policies coordinates measures, within Legislative Decree 81/2008, to ensure that AI introduction and use in workplaces respects health and safety principles.

evidence.quote: assicura il coordinamento delle misure volte a garantire che l'introduzione e l'utilizzo dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale nei contesti lavorativi

obligations.summary: AI systems affecting work organisation, work pace, performance modalities or safety-relevant decisions are assessed within the workplace risk assessment under Art. 28 of Legislative Decree 81/2008.
obligations.conditional_on: AI systems that affect work organisation, production rhythms, performance or safety-relevant decision processes

evidence.quote: è valutato nell'ambito della valutazione dei rischi di cui all'articolo 28 del decreto legislativo n. 81 del 2008

obligations.summary: Employers ensure adequate information and training of workers on the specific risks of AI systems and on the prevention and protection measures adopted.

evidence.quote: I datori di lavoro assicurano un'adeguata informazione e formazione dei lavoratori in merito ai rischi specifici connessi all'utilizzo dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale

obligations.summary: Universities and AFAM institutions must include, in their training activities, integrated technical, legal, functional, ethical and fundamental-rights profiles related to the use of AI systems.

evidence.quote: le attività formative prevedono una formazione integrata dei profili tecnici, giuridici, funzionali, etici e di tutela dei diritti fondamentali della persona

obligations.summary: Training activities must ensure minimum content in relation to AI systems (principles, limits and risks, critical interpretation of outputs, legal and ethical implications, human oversight, cybersecurity), achieved through dedicated courses, integrated modules, labs or internships.
obligations.conditional_on: Proportionate to the type of course and disciplinary profile

evidence.quote: assicurano, in misura proporzionata alla tipologia di corso e al relativo profilo disciplinare, i seguenti contenuti minimi in relazione ai sistemi di intelligenza artificiale

obligations.summary: The Ministry of University and Research carries out annual monitoring of the implementation of Art. 44(1)-(4) in universities and AFAM institutions, based on national quality-assessment data.

evidence.quote: Il Ministero dell'università e della ricerca svolge un'attività di monitoraggio annuale sull'attuazione

obligations.summary: A decree of the Minister of University and Research, after consulting ANVUR, sets the monitoring indicators, operational modalities, criteria and forms of participation in European working groups.

evidence.quote: sono definiti gli indicatori di monitoraggio, le modalità operative in formato compatibile con i sistemi informativi europei

obligations.summary: Justice administration staff training paths must meet the AI literacy obligations of AI Regulation Art. 4, be differentiated by function and risk level and updated periodically, and ensure the competences for human oversight where high-risk systems are used; the Scuola superiore della magistratura trains judges.

evidence.quote: assicurano il rispetto degli obblighi di alfabetizzazione previsti dall'articolo 4 del regolamento IA

obligations.summary: Professional orders and colleges must include AI literacy and training paths in their initial and continuing professional training, covering technical, legal and professional-ethics profiles and a minimum number of hours per continuing-education period; the addressee role here is an approximation for professional bodies.

evidence.quote: I corsi di formazione professionale iniziale e di formazione continua svolti dagli ordini professionali includono percorsi di alfabetizzazione e formazione all'uso dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale

obligations.summary: Within six months, national councils of orders and colleges must amend their training rules to include the AI paths; within six months, the Conferenza permanente must reach an agreement on including AI training in health-profession continuing medical education.
obligations.applies_from: six months from entry into force of this decree

evidence.quote: Entro sei mesi dalla data di entrata in vigore del presente decreto, i consigli nazionali degli ordini e dei collegi

obligations.summary: Public administrations and bodies authorised or accredited for employment services that use AI systems must ensure human oversight, transparency of decisions and protection of users and workers' rights.
obligations.conditional_on: Use of AI systems for employment-service activities under Art. 48(1)

evidence.quote: L'utilizzo dei sistemi di cui al comma 1 è subordinato alla garanzia della supervisione umana, della trasparenza delle decisioni e della tutela dei diritti degli utenti e dei lavoratori

obligations.summary: Within twelve months, the existing decrees on professional fees and the related decrees are supplemented with parameters for fee modulation reflecting the AI system's risk classification.
obligations.applies_from: twelve months from entry into force of this decree

evidence.quote: sono integrati con la determinazione dei parametri utili alla modulazione

obligations.summary: The Committee for financial education promotes and coordinates measures to raise public awareness of opportunities and risks of AI in the financial sector.

evidence.quote: promuove e coordina, anche attraverso l'azione dei suoi componenti, misure atte a sensibilizzare il pubblico

obligations.summary: Continuing education courses for health professionals must include AI literacy and training paths covering technical, legal and professional-ethics profiles.

evidence.quote: I corsi di formazione continua dei professionisti sanitari includono percorsi di alfabetizzazione e formazione all'uso dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale

obligations.summary: Within six months, the National Commission for Continuing Education must set a specific percentage of the triennial individual training obligation for AI paths, and the national agency for regional health services must identify AI training programmes for managerial courses.
obligations.applies_from: six months from entry into force of this decree

evidence.quote: definisce una specifica percentuale dell'obbligo formativo individuale triennale da destinare ai percorsi formativi di cui al comma 1

obligations.summary: The public administrations concerned carry out the activities of the decree using existing human, instrumental and financial resources, without new or greater charges on public finance.

evidence.quote: le amministrazioni interessate provvedono alle attività previste dal presente decreto
